style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Pre-Lit Faux Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Bring festive charm to your home with our luxury pre-lit faux hinged snowy Christmas tree, designed to make a statement in any room. With its full, bushy silhouette and snow-dusted branches, it captures the magic of a white Christmas. The realistic green foliage is generously flocked for a frosty finish, while warm white plug-in lights are pre-woven throughout, casting a gentle glow that brings instant cosiness.<br>Perfect for living rooms, bay windows or entrance halls, this tree offers plenty of space for your favourite decorations while creating a showstopping centrepiece.</p><p>Designed with hinged branches, assembly is quick and hassle-free making it a festive favourite you’ll look forward to bringing out each season.</p><ul><li><strong>Frosted Realistic Branches:</strong> Designed with lifelike green branches dusted in artificial snow, this tree captures the look and feel of a classic winter scene – perfect for adding a touch of seasonal magic to your home</li><li><strong>Pre-Lit With Warm White Lights:</strong> Fitted with warm white plug-in lights, this tree delivers a soft, ambient glow – ideal for creating a cosy and inviting festive atmosphere with no need for separate lighting</li><li><strong>Full, Traditional Shape:</strong> With a wide, bushy silhouette, this tree offers a classic Christmas look and plenty of space for your favourite baubles, decorations, and toppers – making the focal point of any festive display</li><li><strong>Easy To Assemble &amp; Store:</strong> Comes in three hinged sections for quick and simple assembly. The sturdy base ensures stability, allowing for simple storage and continued enjoyment each year<br></li><li><strong>Suitable For Indoor Use:</strong> Ideal for living rooms, hallways, or entrance areas, this tree is designed for indoor use and pairs effortlessly with any traditional or modern Christmas décor style</li><li><strong>Cable length: </strong>210cm</li><li><strong>Tips: </strong>2,043</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Add a festive touch to even the smallest of spaces with our Luxury 3ft pre-lit faux snowy Christmas tree. Featuring snow-dusted green branches and sat nestled in a hessian-style bag, this thoughtfully designed piece has a compact base, making it the perfect fit for tabletops, sideboards and entryways. Warm white plug-in LED lights are pre-fitted throughout, casting a soft, ambient glow that brings instant warmth and cheer. Ideal for adding festive flair to any corner of your home, with no assembly required, this piece is a stylish favourite you’ll enjoy for seasons to come. Compact and stylish design: Measuring 92cm tall, this small frosted Christmas tree is perfect for tabletops, sideboards, desks and entryways, ideal for adding festive charm to smaller spaces without overwhelming the room. Pre-lit with warm white LEDs: Fitted with warm white plug-in LED lights, this tree delivers a soft, ambient glow, ideal for creating a cosy and inviting festive atmosphere with no need for separate lighting. Frosted realistic branches: Designed with lifelike green branches dusted in artificial snow, this tree captures the look and feel of a classic winter scene, perfect for adding a touch of seasonal magic to your home. Ready to display: Nestled in a hessian-style sack base for a natural, handcrafted look, this tree arrives pre-assembled and ready to enjoy straight from the box, with no setup required. Festive favourite: Designed for indoor use, this mini tree is a convenient and charming seasonal accent you’ll look forward to displaying year after year. Dimensions: Tree height: 92cm. Tree width: 76cm. Base height: 10cm. Weight: 2.5kg. Cable length: 90cm. Tips: 584. Additional information: Battery operated, requires 3 x AA batteries (batteries are not included).
